summary: Frontend-only verification of recent UI/behavior changes on Dashboard, ScheduleForm, PublicJadwal and Display. All 8 requested behaviors verified via Playwright against the public preview URL. All checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js uses localStorage key 'rapat_token' (OK). Just a note for next testers: when scripting cleanup via fetch, use localStorage.getItem('rapat_token').

ScheduleForm `openEnded` toggle resets Jam Selesai to '09:00' when unchecked — correct, but if the user had changed start-time to >=09:00 beforehand this could later be flagged by the 'jam selesai > jam mulai' validation. Minor UX nit, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 schedules during testing (TEST_UnitKerja on 2026-10-20, TEST_OpenEnded on 2026-10-21 with jam_selesai='Selesai'). Both deleted via API after verification (DELETE 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified: (1) count-terjadwal chip present ('6 Terjadwal') and old stats-panel removed; (2) required-field asterisks on Tanggal, Ruangan, Jam Mulai, Jam Selesai, Pengguna, Petugas Pencatat; (3) toast validation messages 'Pilih ruangan' / 'Isi pengguna / unit kerja' / 'Pilih petugas pencatat' fire in order; Kegiatan empty does NOT block submission; (4) Submitting with only required fields filled succeeds (toast 'Jadwal berhasil ditambahkan'); (5) form-selesai-toggle switches Jam Selesai input to readonly value 'Selesai' and schedule saves successfully (dashboard shows '14:00 - Selesai'); (6) Overlapping schedule in same room/date as open-ended rejected with 409 and toast 'Bentrok jadwal! Ruangan Olah Bebaya sudah dipakai 14:00-Selesai'; (7) Public /jadwal headers = ['Tanggal','Ruangan','Waktu','Pengguna','Kegiatan/Rapat','Fasilitas'] — no Pencatat/Surat; (8) /display shows 'Informasi Jadwal Ruang Rapat', clock in HH.MM (e.g. 15.17), times use dots (e.g. '09.00 - 11.00'), open-ended displayed as 'Selesai', rows compact and no red row background. Login token key is 'rapat_token' in localStorage for any API cleanup scripts.
